[source_id=75] Due to space limitation, we only show results in figures in the paper. All numerical numbers used for plotting Figure FIGREF17 are presented in Table TABREF38 . We can observe that DAS-EM, DAS-SE, and DAS all achieve substantial improvements over baseline methods under different settings.
